title: Finite limits and restriction comparisons for the localized inverse image
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-slice-site-localization, after the slice functor is continuous and its sheaf pushforward has a right adjoint, the induced sheaf inverse image on the slice preserves finite limits and its composites with the localized restriction functors admit the canonical inverse-image and direct-image comparison isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 03CF, middle diagram and final paragraph

proof.text: Identify sheaves on each localized slice with sheaves over the sheafified representable using Tag 00Y1, then transport the global inverse image across these equivalences. The fibre formula gives the inverse-image comparison and the sectionwise direct-image comparison.

theorem sliceSheafInverseImage_remainder
    {D : Type u} {C : Type v} [SmallCategory D] [SmallCategory C]
    (K : GrothendieckTopology D) (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (u : D ⥤ C)
    [u.IsContinuous K J]
    [(u.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (max u v)) K J).IsRightAdjoint]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (u.sheafPullback (Type (max u v)) K J)]
    (V : D) [(Over.post (X := V) u).IsContinuous (K.over V) (J.over (u.obj V))]
    [((Over.post (X := V) u).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (max u v))
      (K.over V) (J.over (u.obj V))).IsRightAdjoint] :
    PreservesFiniteLimits ((Over.post (X := V) u).sheafPullback (Type (max u v))
      (K.over V) (J.over (u.obj V))) ∧
    Nonempty (K.overPullback (Type (max u v)) V ⋙
      (Over.post (X := V) u).sheafPullback (Type (max u v)) (K.over V) (J.over (u.obj V)) ≅
      u.sheafPullback (Type (max u v)) K J ⋙ J.overPullback (Type (max u v)) (u.obj V)) ∧
    Nonempty (u.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (max u v)) K J ⋙ K.overPullback
      (Type (max u v)) V ≅ J.overPullback (Type (max u v)) (u.obj V) ⋙
      (Over.post (X := V) u).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (max u v))
        (K.over V) (J.over (u.obj V)))
